The Tilinca (Romanian pipe) is an Eastern European folk flute, an aerophone, Hornbostel–Sachs 421.111-1. It is an overtone flute without fingerholes and can be seen as an early form of the dentsivka; the player puts a finger into the end of the tube, covering about half or a third of the opening, and changes pitch with the strength of the breath. The instrument is common in Romania, especially in the regions next to Ukrainian Bukovina; in the Kalush Orchestra's 2022 song Stefania it also appears alongside the sopilka, and that song won the Eurovision Song Contest.

此樂器為東歐民間笛，屬泛音笛，為無指孔的登齊夫卡（dentsivka）原始形態。: This is an Eastern European folk flute, an overtone flute and the fingerhole-less early form of the dentsivka. Its transmission shows regional variation: it is common in Romania, especially in the areas bordering Ukrainian Bukovina, where it is called tilinca; the Romanian version without a top end is often confused with the Hungarian tilinko, which has one, is easier for beginners and resembles the fingerhole-less Romanian kaval. An important recent change in use was its prominent appearance, with the sopilka, in the Kalush Orchestra's 2022 song Stefania, which won Ukraine the Eurovision Song Contest.

The source states only that the tube is made of lime, elder, sycamore or willow wood, and mentions no material for a reed, fipple, fingerholes or other parts. It works as an overtone flute, changing pitch by how much of the tube end a finger covers and by the strength of the breath, but the materials of these parts are not recorded.
演奏時以手固定管身，將手指伸入管口開口處，遮蓋一半、三分之一等不同比例，再以吹氣: To play, hold the tube steady with one hand, put a finger into the open end and cover half, a third or another fraction of it, then change pitch with the strength of the breath. The flute has no fingerholes, so the pitch cannot be changed by stopping holes; the first task for a beginner is a steady airstream and control of the covered area. The source notes that the Romanian tilinca, without a top end, is often confused with the Hungarian tilinko, which has one; the latter suits beginners better.

羅馬尼亞笛音色清澈明亮，具有穿透力強的特性。其聲音帶有自然的溫潤感，卻不失清脆的: The Romanian pipe's timbre is clear and bright and carries strongly. The sound has a natural warmth without losing a crisp texture, sitting between the plainness of a folk flute and the finesse of a modern one. The range is fairly wide; by changing how much of the opening the finger covers and how hard the breath is, the player gets rich layers of overtones, from deep and full to high and transparent. Its resonance is distinctive, the column of air inside the tube giving a colourful timbre. Beside the brilliance of the Western flute and the rawness of other folk flutes, the Romanian pipe has both plainness and expressive power. The timbre is strongly national in character and pastoral in flavour, and can express feeling that is both tender and cheerful.
